name: Small Angel Statue (Ramiel's Charge)
description: A small, intricately carved stone statue of an angel with outspread wings. The base is inscribed with 'Ramiel's Charge'. The statue feels cool to the touch.

params.message: The statue is exquisitely detailed. The angel's face is serene, wings spread as if in mid-flight. The inscription 'Ramiel's Charge' is carved in elegant script along the base.
